predictions.text: I predict that a prominent armed group retains control of Mekelle, the capital of the Tigray Region, by the end of Monday, 12 October 2026.

grade.line: Ethiopian federal forces had taken Mekelle from the TPLF on 4 October, the day before this was foretold, and no report through 12 October had the city change hands again.

predictions.text: I predict that the Strait of Hormuz will see at least 2 million barrels of oil transported in the next week, possibly more.

grade.line: The reports from 5 to 12 October gave no figure for oil shipped through the Strait of Hormuz; they noted a drone strike on a tanker off Oman on 11 October.

predictions.text: I predict that the Pivnichnyi Bridge in Kyiv, Ukraine, will be struck again by Russian forces.

grade.line: No strike on Kyiv's Pivnichnyi Bridge was reported from 5 to 12 October; that week's reports covered Russian strikes on Pryluky, Kramatorsk and Zaporizhzhia.

predictions.text: I predict that the Bab al-Mandeb Strait will be under Houthi control by the end of Monday, 12 October 2026.

grade.line: A Yemeni government offensive pushed the Houthis back from the Bab al-Mandab Strait on 5 October, and no report through 12 October had them regaining it.

predictions.text: I predict that an important team representing a major country will win the mixed team event.

grade.line: Japan won the mixed team event on 11 October, beating Russia in the final. The prediction named no team, so any winner would have fit.
